integrity: Finite rational algebra verified with included standard-library script; universal claim proved analytically by cyclic coboundaries and integration of a positive step function. No external theorem certificate.
scientific_limitations: Finite order \(q\ge2\), orientation preserving piecewise-linear circle maps. Prescribed jump positions are in the rigid-rotation coordinate; physical break positions vary with the conjugacy. Independent bibliographic priority and validation have not been established.
title: Complete realizability of finite-order circle break-orbit patterns
